ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 - Administrative Measures for Beneficial Ownership Information, effective 1 November 2024; Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2025 revision); Company Law of the PRC (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024); Regulations on the Administration of Foundations (2004, as amended); PRC Administrative Reconsideration Law.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), People's Republic of China, or delegated local municipal SAMR
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route only: (1) notarize a conformed copy of the original Business License before a PRC notary public; (2) obtain an apostille from the designated PRC Foreign Affairs Office or provincial foreign affairs office; (3) deliver the apostilled instrument directly to the Taiwan-region receiving authority. Consular legalization must not be added because the PRC is a Contracting Party to the Hague Apostille Convention.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: SAMR local municipal market-regulation bureau or the authorized registration authority retaining the company file
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route only: obtain the original Certificate of Good Standing from SAMR, notarize the copy before a PRC notary, then submit to the competent PRC foreign affairs office for an apostille. The apostilled certificate is forwarded directly to the Taiwan-region authority without any consular legalization step.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney (PoA)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors or shareholders of the PRC WFOE, attested by the company seal and legal representative signature
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route only: the Board Resolution and PoA must be signed in the presence of a PRC notary public, the notarial certificate is then submitted to the PRC provincial foreign affairs office for apostille. The complete apostilled package is delivered to the Taiwan-region receiving party. No consular legalization may be applied.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (Memorandum and Articles of Association)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: SAMR-registered WFOE and the SAMR file containing the approved Articles of Association
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route only: certify the Articles of Association as a true copy from SAMR, have the certified copy notarized before a PRC notary, and obtain an apostille from the PRC competent foreign affairs office. The apostilled Articles are transmitted to the Taiwan-region authority in parallel; consular legalization is not required and must not be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: PBOC-regulated licensed commercial bank maintaining the corporate account of the PRC WFOE
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route only: the Bank Reference Letter is issued on bank stationery and sealed by the bank officer; the bank signature authenticity is notarized by a PRC notary, and the notarized letter is apostilled by the PRC Foreign Affairs Office. The apostilled Bank Reference Letter is delivered directly to the recipient. Consular legalization is not applicable to PRC-origin documents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized UBO Declaration and Control-Chain Chart
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ultimate beneficial owners and the corporate governance body of the PRC WFOE, notarized in the PRC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route only: the UBO Declaration is signed and authenticated before a PRC notary, then apostilled by the designated PRC foreign-affairs office. The apostilled declaration is transmitted directly to the Taiwan-region regulator and the receiving government authority. No consular legalization step shall be added.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Prior to incorporation and on an ongoing basis, the WFOE and its ultimate beneficial owners, directors, authorized signatories, grantees, donors, and material counterparties must be screened against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the UN Security Council sanctions lists, the PRC foreign-ministry sanctions designations, and the Taiwan-region financial supervisory designation lists. Politically exposed persons, including domestic, foreign, and international-organization PEPs as well as their family members and close associates, must be identified through reliable public and commercial databases. Enhanced due diligence, including source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification, independent corroboration of beneficial ownership, adverse-media monitoring, and continuous transaction screening, is mandatory for any PEP or sanctioned-risk hit. All screening results must be documented and retained under PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 record-keeping obligations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR Enterprise Name Self-Service Declaration Platform, operated through the National Enterprise Registration Online Service and the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name of a PRC WFOE must be composed in simplified Chinese characters using the statutory four-tier sequence: administrative division plus distinct trade name plus industry or business characteristic plus legal form. Latin script may be used only as an additional transliterated trade name after the Chinese name is approved and cannot replace the Chinese name. Pinyin transliteration must correspond phonetically to the approved Chinese trade name. In the Taiwan-region filing, traditional Chinese equivalents may be used for correspondence, but the core registered legal name remains the approved PRC simplified-Chinese name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 15 working days after a negative name-clearance decision, the applicant must submit a written administrative reconsideration application to the local SAMR market-regulation bureau or the next-higher SAMR authority under the PRC Administrative Reconsideration Law. The appeal must attach the original name-reservation receipt, the rejection notice, the proposed corrected four-tier name, and documentary proof of a valid prior-use right or ministerial pre-approval if the rejection concerned an identical or similar trade name. If the administrative reconsideration fails, the applicant may file an administrative lawsuit within six months before the competent people's court. The name reservation window may be restored after a successful appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices and commercial mail-forwarding addresses are not acceptable as the sole registered office for an ISIC 6430 charitable endowment foundation structured as a PRC WFOE. The PRC Company Law and the Regulations on the Administration of Foundations require a fixed business premises that can accommodate the filing cabinet, board minutes, UBO records, grant contracts, and financial books. SAMR and the tax authorities regard a mailbox-only address as an indicator of shell-formation risk. Local branches of the tax bureau and commercial bank account-application teams will inspect the premises or require the lease registration, utility bills, payment vouchers, and photographs before issuance of tax registration and bank account opening. A virtual office may be used only for secondary correspondence after a physical operating address and statutory premises are established.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 70% likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection by the municipal SAMR or tax bureau within the first 12 months after incorporation, and 90% likelihood within 24 months if the entity applies for tax-exempt status or receives inbound grant wire transfers. Checklist that triggers inspection: (1) mismatch between registered address and actual office; (2) inability to produce original licenses or board minutes; (3) no employees or payroll records; (4) grant distribution without proper due diligence files; (5) absence of UBO register; (6) virtual-office address; (7) nominee directors or inconsistent PoA; (8) cash or wire flows from high-risk jurisdictions. Inspection risk is High.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act of Taiwan, as amended, particularly Articles 1, 4, 8, 12, 15, 18, 29, 98 to 113 concerning limited liability companies, registered office, responsible person, and company registration; Foreign Investment Act Articles 4, 6, 7 and 10 concerning foreign investor approvals; and, in the event the beneficial owner is a Mainland China entity or resident, Article 73 of the Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area and the Regulations on Permission of Investment in Taiwan from Mainland China.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) through the local municipal Department of Economic Development with jurisdiction over the registered office (for example, Taipei City Government for Taipei-registered companies); foreign investment admission and special Mainland China investor review is administered by the Investment Commission, MOEA.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Company Registration of a Limited Liability Company together with the formally executed and adopted Articles of Incorporation, filed through the MOEA Company and Commercial Registration Information System and accepted by the local municipal company registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Statutory minimum paid-up capital: None under the Taiwan Company Act for a limited liability company without special licensing. However, the subscribed capital must be fully paid in and remitted to a temporary capital verification account opened in the proposed company name at a Taiwanese bank; the funds must remain blocked for the account holder's operations pending the certified public accountant's capital verification report and the successful company registration filing. No formal state-mandated escrow regime applies beyond this bank-level verification-and-hold instruction.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF CN_WFOE_LTD
(Adopted by written consent in lieu of a meeting pursuant to the Company Act of Taiwan)

WHEREAS, the company is proposed to be incorporated as a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company under the Company Act of Taiwan for the purpose of endowment management for philanthropic and scientific grants, such business being classified under ISIC 6430;

WHEREAS, the Investment Commission of the Ministry of Economic Affairs has conditionally approved the foreign investment application, and all filings will be made subject to any restrictions contained in that approval;

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS:

1. RESOLVED, that the authorized capital contribution of the company shall be TWD [amount], divided into [number] capital contribution quotas, fully subscribed by the sole shareholder and allocated as [equity interest] percent, and that such capital contribution shall be remitted to the company's temporary capital verification account with [Bank] in Taiwan before the registration application is filed.

2. RESOLVED, that the Articles of Incorporation, in the form attached hereto, are approved and adopted; the chairman and/or the responsible person is directed to sign the Articles and to file the incorporation application with the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs and the local municipal competent authority within the statutory period.

3. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the company shall be located at [address] in [city, Taiwan]; such office is adopted as the company's principal place of business and legal domicile; no physical manufacturing, warehousing, chemical or industrial operation will be conducted at such office.

4. RESOLVED, that the following persons are appointed to the statutory offices of the company: [name] as director and chairman; [name] as manager and general secretary; [name] as chief financial officer; and [name] as compliance officer. Each officer shall hold office until removed by the shareholder or until a successor is appointed.

5. RESOLVED, that the chairman, together with any one of the chief financial officer or the compliance officer, is authorized to open, operate, close, pledge and manage bank accounts with [Bank] and all relevant financial institutions, to sign all account mandate forms, wire transfer instructions, grant disbursement instructions, and tax administration letters. Two signatures shall be required for every grant distribution or fund transfer exceeding TWD [threshold].

6. RESOLVED, that the company shall adopt the proposed corporate seal and registered company chop, maintain statutory registers, publish registered details, and comply with the anti-money-laundering requirements applicable to authorized endowment funds.

7. RESOLVED, that the appropriate regulatory permits, including any Charitable Foundation Establishment Permit, Foundation Registration or Juridical Person Registration Certificate, and tax registration, shall be applied for and obtained before any granting activity is carried on.

8. RESOLVED, that the responsible person is authorized to use all reasonable efforts to satisfy any query, objection or administrative request issued by the competent authorities and, where required by law, to cure the objection within the prescribed period.

This resolution shall be effective as of the date of signature below and may be executed in counterparts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Application and Special Mainland China Investor Review
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan - One-Stop Online Investment Application Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the foreign-investment application online at the Investment Commission portal using the new wholly foreign-owned limited liability company application form, and attach a duly executed power of attorney. If the ultimate beneficial owner is a Mainland China enterprise or resident, the special cross-strait investment review under Article 73 of the Relations Act will apply; the investor must disclose source of funds, business plan and proposed charitable objects. Submit certified true copies of the shareholder's articles or corporate registration, passport or national identity document, a stamped resolution approving the investment, and a financial statement. If requested, attend an interview and respond to supplemental questionnaire within ten working days. The Commission will issue a conditional or unconditional investment approval letter, which is a prerequisite for bank account opening and company registration.
required_dossiers: Investment application form
Power of attorney appointing local agent or attorney
Certified corporate registration certificate or investor passport
Resolved board or shareholder investment approval
Business plan and philanthropic grant-making purpose statement
Source-of-funds certificate and financial statements
Mainland China investor questionnaires and cross-strait disclosures if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Commission issues a deficiency letter or rejects the application, file a supplemental response within ten to fifteen working days; if rejected, submit an administrative appeal to the Executive Yuan within thirty days or re-file after correcting prohibited investment scope or ownership.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company and Commercial Registration Information System, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receipt of the investment approval letter, conduct an online company name pre-screening with the Company and Commercial Registration Information System maintained by the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs. The proposed English and Mandarin-language company name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered corporate name or a well-known trademark; a name reservation is valid for six months. The application must include the exact legal form, namely a limited liability company, the proposed address in Taiwan, and a business scope limited to endowment management under ISIC 6430 and philanthropic grant-making. The registry will produce a name pre-approval certificate; this certificate must accompany the incorporation filing. If the applicant is represented by an agent, provide a notarized power of attorney and identification of the agent.
required_dossiers: Investment Approval Letter from MOEA Investment Commission
Company name pre-screening application
Statement of proposed business scope using ISIC 6430
Mandarin and English company name alternatives
Notarized power of attorney and agent identification
Declaration of lawful charitable purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, immediately submit two alternative names; if the rejection is considered erroneous, file a written appeal with the Department of Commerce within fifteen days and, where appropriate, obtain a trademark search opinion from the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Articles, Capital Remittance and CPA Capital Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan commercial bank corporate account desk, foreign currency deposit unit, appointed certified public accountant, and the inward remittance monitoring unit ---- subject to the Investment Commission, MOEA for capital remittance approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before filing the company registration, establish a temporary capital verification account in the proposed company name at a Taiwanese bank branch; remit the subscribed capital from the overseas shareholder's bank account by wire. The funds must be held until the certified public accountant issues a capital verification report confirming lawful inward remittance and full payment of capital. The CPA report must be dated within the fifteen-day period before filing and must state the paid-up amount, the bank, the remittance record, and the absence of encumbrances. The bank will keep the account under a blocked or escrow instruction; no withdrawals will be permitted except to pay registration fees or after registration to transfer into the company's ordinary operating account. If the inward remittance reference number does not match the statutory declaration, correct the reference code and resubmit before the bank records the amount.
required_dossiers: Conditional or unconditional Investment Approval Letter
Name pre-approval certificate from MOEA company registry
Proposed Articles of Incorporation
Bank account opening application and seal card instruction
Overseas shareholder remittance instruction and wire record
Inward remittance reference and source-of-funds declaration
CPA engagement letter and draft capital verification report
Passport or ID of the responsible person
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or authority issues an anti-money-laundering query, provide the shareholder's source-of-funds declaration and supporting financial records; if the CPA report is deficient, obtain a revised report before withdrawing funds; if the remittance is suspended, submit the bank's required foreign exchange declaration and recommence the wire with the corrected reference.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Registration Filing and Issuance of Incorporation Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local municipal Department of Economic Development exercising the delegated company registration function under the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), through the MOEA online company registration system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the company registration application package to the local municipal department of economic development through the MOEA company registration online system, using the investment approval letter, the name pre-approval certificate, the CPA capital verification report, the executed Articles of Incorporation, the written consent of the registered office owner or lease agreement and building use certificate, identity documents of the responsible person, and the seal card. Ensure all foreign-language documents are notarized and authenticated; documents issued in Mainland China require cross-strait notarization and verification. The registry will examine the lawful business scope, capital, and responsible person capacity. After the examination, the registry issues a company registration certificate and a uniform company identification number. Then apply for tax registration with the National Taxation Administration branch with jurisdiction over the registered office.
required_dossiers: Company registration application form
Executed and notarized Articles of Incorporation
CPA capital verification report
Foreign Investment Commission approval letter
Company name pre-approval certificate
Registered office lease or ownership deed and building usage consent
Identity documents of the responsible person and directors
Corporate seal card and specimen signatures
Power of attorney if filing through an agent
Tax registration application for subsequent tax authority filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry raises a defect or suspends the application, cure the omission within fifteen working days; if registration is refused due to registered office defects, submit a revised lease and lawful building use certificate; if refusal is not remediable, file an administrative appeal to MOEA within thirty days of receipt of the refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Charitable Foundation Operating Permit, Juridical Person Registration and AML/Tax Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Health and Welfare or other purpose-based central competent authority for charitable foundations, the local district court for juridical person registration, and the National Taxation Administration for tax and charity exemption filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the charitable foundation establishment permit and juridical person registration before commencing grant-making activities. The competent authority will review the endowment instrument, charitable purpose, board of trustees, financial projections, and internal control policies. After receiving the permit, apply to the local district court for juridical person registration under the Civil Code, and file with the tax office for income tax exemption and donation receipts. Because the entity is a foreign-invested WFOE, it must also keep the MOEA Investment Commission informed of any change in the charitable purpose or capital use, and should implement the bank anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing policies for the endowment's wire-based grant distribution and bank-wire payment rails. Confirm with the Financial Supervisory Commission whether a separate trust or fund license is required for any custodial or investment service beyond simple grant distribution.
required_dossiers: Charitable foundation establishment application
Foundation charter or endowment instrument
Board of trustees roster and consent forms
Financial plan and projected grant-making budget
Proof of endowment capital and bank custody account
Company registration certificate and uniform identification number
Investment Commission approval and any capital use approval
Tax registration form and donation receipt application
AML/CFT program for bank-wire and grant-distribution processes
Building use consent for the registered office if charitable activities are conducted at that address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the competent authority withholds the foundation permit, amend the endowment instrument or financial plan and resubmit within thirty days; if the district court rejects juridical person registration, correct asset proof or governance provisions and re-file; for tax-related rejection, file a written objection with the National Taxation Administration within thirty days of the assessment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable to industrial manufacturing, warehousing, chemical or physical assembly operations because the registered activity is ISIC 6430 endowment management for philanthropic and scientific grants; for the charitable foundation operating authority, the competent body is the Ministry of Health and Welfare Social Welfare Department or other purpose-based central competent authority, together with the local municipal social welfare department.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Charitable Foundation Establishment Permit and Juridical Person (Foundation) Registration Certificate; no physical industrial operating license or manufacturing permit is required for ISIC 6430.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Administration (EPA), Executive Yuan, Taiwan ---- not applicable to pure endowment management; if a future registered-office tenant improvement project triggers construction waste, indoor air quality or building renovation rules, the local municipal Environmental Protection Bureau must be consulted.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Not Applicable because the entity conducts no manufacturing, chemical, assembly, warehousing or other EIA-triggering physical activity under ISIC 6430.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - zero industrial discharge sources; no wastewater, VOC, hazardous waste or air emission thresholds apply. Office waste must be disposed through the municipal licensed waste collection system, and any tenant-improvement construction waste, if generated, must be removed by an Environmental Protection Bureau-licensed transporter.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense industrial fire permits: Not Applicable because ISIC 6430 involves no hazardous industrial premises. The registered office must, however, obtain a commercial building fire safety compliance certificate from the local fire department under the National Fire Agency of the Ministry of the Interior. If employees are retained, the workplace must comply with the Occupational Safety and Health Act, including general office safety, emergency exits, first-aid equipment, and a hazard notification program; a written workplace self-assessment and fire-evacuation plan should be kept at the registered office.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance (Taiwan) - National Taxation Administration, with district tax offices; online electronic portals: Ministry of Finance e-Tax Service Portal and E-Invoice Integrated Service Platform
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: For a foreign non-resident enterprise creating a Taiwan fixed place of business, first complete the required juridical person, branch, or foundation registration with the Taiwan central competent authority and obtain establishment approval and business registration. Step 2: Before business commences, and generally within 15 days after the establishment approval, file the profit-seeking enterprise tax registration with the competent National Taxation Administration district office or use the e-Tax Service Portal. Step 3: The National Taxation Administration will assign the statutory tax registration number (Uniform Number/Tax ID) used for business tax, Uniform Invoices, customs declarations, and all tax return filing. Step 4: A foreign non-resident entity with no Taiwan fixed place of business that supplies cross-border electronic services to Taiwan individual consumers is exempt from registration until annual Taiwanese-source B2C digital service turnover exceeds TWD 480,000; once the threshold is crossed, it must register under the cross-border electronic services business tax facility, appoint a Taiwan tax agent, and file the same business tax returns. Step 5: A charitable endowment foundation should also apply for recognition under Article 4 of the Income Tax Act as an educational, cultural, public welfare, or charitable organization so that qualifying grant and endowment income remains exempt while nonexempt business or investment income remains taxable at the entity level.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None - Taiwan does not provide check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections for the CN_WFOE_LTD; the profit-seeking enterprise is taxed at the entity level, and qualifying charitable foundations separately apply for statutory income-tax exemption.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Business Tax (VAT/GST equivalent under the Business Tax Act, covering value-added and non-value-added business tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No registration threshold for a Taiwan fixed place of business; registration is mandatory before taxable business begins. For a foreign non-resident supplier of cross-border electronic services, registration is triggered only when annual B2C sales to Taiwan individual consumers exceed TWD 480,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Taiwan requires taxable profit-seeking enterprises to issue Uniform Invoices for taxable supplies. Electronic uniform invoices are issued through the Ministry of Finance E-Invoice Integrated Service Platform using approved turnkey or API interfaces (JSON/XML); B2B invoice details are captured during the bi-monthly business tax return cycle, while B2C e-invoices must be transmitted to the cloud platform within the prescribed upload window (generally 48 hours). Taiwan does not operate real-time fiscal clearance or anti-fraud digital stamping; integrity is enforced through unique Uniform Invoice numbering, statutory business tax ID cross-checks, and the platform's anti-duplication validation controls.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A Taiwan-registered enterprise may claim the 0% business tax rate for (1) goods physically exported from Taiwan customs territory to an overseas buyer, and (2) qualifying offshore or cross-border electronic/digital services supplied by a Taiwan business to an overseas recipient or actually consumed outside Taiwan. The claimant must establish through customs and commercial records that the goods or services left the Taiwan economic territory, that a genuine sale occurred, and that the foreign currency consideration was, or within 180 days will be, repatriated to Taiwan. Input VAT attributable to zero-rated export supplies is creditable and may be refunded through the bi-monthly business tax return.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (export entry or export manifest) filed with Taiwan Customs evidencing physical export of goods
Ocean Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing carriage to the overseas consignee
Foreign exchange settlement certificate or inward foreign remittance record issued by a Taiwan foreign-exchange bank
Uniform Invoice or export invoice issued to the overseas buyer showing zero-rated export sale
Export contract, purchase order, pro forma invoice, and packing list proving transaction terms, value, and counterparty
For exported services: service agreement, offshore usage or consumption evidence, and delivery/receipt records confirming the recipient is outside Taiwan
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The National Taxation Administration and Taiwan Customs may audit zero-rating claims within the statutory assessment period, generally five years and seven years for proven fraud. If the documentation bundle is missing, inconsistent, or counterfeit, the zero rate is denied, output business tax is retroactively assessed at 5%, input tax credits or refunds are clawed back with interest and late surcharge, and administrative penalties up to five times the evaded tax may be imposed. Export proceeds not repatriated within the 180-day deadline may be recharacterized as domestic taxable sales, resulting in additional 5% business tax, interest, penalties, and possible criminal liability for deliberate tax evasion or forgery of export and foreign-exchange documentation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBOC) governs all FX and cross-border RMB flows for the mainland WFOE; the Taiwan Central Bank (CBC) supervises the Taiwan-side RMB clearing conducted through Bank of China (Taipei branch).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: RMB is fully convertible for current account items (trade, services, dividends) subject to authentic-transaction verification, but strictly controlled on the capital account. The WFOE's inbound equity injection is a capital-account event requiring SAFE FDI registration, a dedicated capital escrow account, and post-settlement use verification. Outbound grant and profit remittances are subject to single-payment tax filing (对外支付税务备案) for amounts above USD 50,000 and SAFE purpose-code declaration. Taiwan-sourced funds are treated as cross-strait FDI requiring MOEAIC investment approval on the Taiwan side and SAFE FDI registration on the mainland side; full repatriation of registered capital is permitted only after liquidation or equity transfer, whereas current-account profits are remittable annually upon audited financial statements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: China abolished blanket mandatory FX surrender in 2012. Goods-trade export proceeds must be repatriated into a domestic FX account within 90 days of customs declaration; services-trade proceeds within 180 days; exporters may freely hold or convert retained FX and must report through the SAFE Trade Monitoring System. The charitable endowment WFOE (ISIC 6430) has no core export exposure; the only applicable obligation is repatriation and declaration of incidental receipts (e.g., licensing or consulting fees) under the relevant timeline, with no mandatory conversion ratio unless a local SAFE circular imposes a minimum settlement percentage for cross-strait transactions.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low (feasibility rating 2/10). Offshore digital EMIs (Airwallex, Payoneer, Currenxie, Wise) are not licensed by PBOC/SAFE to open corporate current or capital accounts for a mainland WFOE; they may only aggregate small-value e-commerce receipts through licensed Chinese PSPs (Alipay, Tenpay). Such EMIs cannot handle FDI capital injection, capital escrow, or charitable grant outflows, and their use would breach SAFE capital-account rules and trigger AML red flags. They are excluded from the primary treasury rail and serve at most as a supplementary collection conduit for small charitable donations routed through a licensed PSP partner.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is not mandatory for the PRC-resident legal representative in standard branch onboarding, but the Taiwan-invested shareholder's authorized signatory and UBO must attend either an in-person interview at the mainland branch or, at branch discretion for Low_Risk_Standard clients, a remote video interview supported by notarized cross-strait authorization (经台湾公证并经海基会核验的授权书). Non-resident directors must present original passports or Mainland Travel Permits for Taiwan Residents (台胞证), plus board resolutions and a completed AML/UBO questionnaire. Enhanced due diligence applies if the UBO is a politically exposed person in Taiwan, requiring additional source-of-wealth evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Entity is a private charitable foundation with no commercial revenue, creating NPO/sanctions classification risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Foundation registration certificate, articles of association, board grant-approval policy, sample grant award agreements, audited financial statements for two fiscal years, and a written undertaking confirming no sanctions or terrorist-financing links.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Taiwan-based foreign shareholder/UBO triggers cross-strait CFT and politically exposed person scrutiny.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UBO identification documents (passport or 台胞证), source-of-funds evidence (bank statements, tax returns, Taiwan Investment Commission approval), notarized corporate registry extract, and signed AML questionnaire.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection with ambiguous purpose code or mismatch between remitter and registered shareholder.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE FDI registration certificate, business license, capital contribution schedule, MOEAIC investment approval, and remittance instruction referencing 'Registered Capital Contribution' with the correct SAFE transaction code.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound grant disbursements to Taiwan beneficiaries may be viewed as disguised capital flight.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed grant agreements with named Taiwan counterparties, board resolutions approving each grant, evidence of charitable purpose (ISIC 6430 / NAICS 813211), outward-payment tax filing certificate (对外支付税务备案), and post-disbursement beneficiary receipts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High transaction velocity or unexpected cash concentration in a low-revenue endowment account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Endowment portfolio segregation statement, grant disbursement calendar, monthly bank reconciliation, investment custody reports, and explanatory board minutes.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Taiwan shareholder funds must be remitted via SWIFT MT103 from Bank of China (Taipei branch) or a Taiwan OBU to the WFOE's designated capital escrow account at the mainland lead bank. The remitter must exactly match the registered shareholder; field 70 must state 'Cross-Strait FDI – Registered Capital Contribution' and reference the SAFE FDI registration certificate; the correct SAFE capital-account transaction code must be quoted. On receipt, the bank reports to SAFE's Capital Account Information System and credits the foreign-exchange capital account. RMB conversion is permitted under discretionary settlement (意愿结汇) into a settlement-pending-payment account (结汇待支付账户), with each subsequent RMB payment supported by invoices or contracts. The Taiwan side must hold MOEAIC investment approval and CBC outward-remittance clearance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Grant and operating outflows clear via (i) SWIFT MT103 USD wires using SAFE current-account purpose code 721090 for grants or 122990 for service fees, each payment above USD 50,000 requiring prior outward-payment tax filing (对外支付税务备案); (ii) RMB cross-border payments through CIPS using Bank of China (Taipei) as clearing bank for Taiwan-side credits; and (iii) documentary Commercial Letters of Credit only if the foundation undertakes permitted trade-service activities under ISIC 6430 — in practice, the charitable structure precludes L/C usage, and direct verified remittance is the sole compliant rail for Taiwan grant distribution.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore RMB/USD forward contracts (远期结售汇) with a licensed bank under the real-demand principle, tenor 3-12 months, backed by forecasted current-account receipts or FDI-related outflows.

Onshore RMB/USD FX options (purchased European options or zero-premium collars) permitted for verified current-account exposure, subject to SAFE real-demand verification and prohibition of speculative positions.
Cross-currency swaps (货币掉期) converting floating-rate endowment income into fixed-rate RMB or USD, executed under a SAFE-approved derivative framework agreement.
Cross-strait RMB/TWD implicit forwards settled via USD crossing at Bank of China (Taipei), permissible solely for verified grant or trade flows.

Onshore synthetic forwards (差额交割) for RMB/TWD or other non-deliverable currency exposures are permissible under CIPS real-demand rules; direct RMB/USD NDFs are prohibited onshore, and offshore NDF participation by the WFOE requires prior SAFE no-objection.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Shareholders' Annual General Meeting approval of audited financial statements, business report, and profit distribution or loss absorption plan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' meeting convened by the board of directors as the internal corporate governance organ
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year end, i.e., by 30 June for a calendar-year company, unless extension is granted by the competent authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Responsible director may incur an administrative fine; the competent authority may order rectification within a prescribed period; continued failure may lead to compulsory winding-up or dissolution proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual company registration filing of approved financial statements, business report, and related corporate data to the central company registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (ROC Central Company Registration and Commercial Information Platform)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the shareholders' meeting approval; for a calendar-year entity with AGM held on 30 June, filing is due by 30 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine for the company or responsible person of NT$10,000–NT$500,000; repeated failures trigger an order to file and may result in cancellation of registration or administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual substantial controller (UBO) declaration covering directors, supervisors, managers, and shareholders holding more than 10% of shares
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (Company UBO / Information Filing System)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January of the following calendar year for information as of 31 December; any change must be filed within 15 days after the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Immediate administrative fine of NT$50,000–NT$500,000; per-day fines may be imposed for continuing non-compliance; false declarations may expose the responsible person to enhanced penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (profit-seeking enterprise income tax return), including retained earnings tax and alternative minimum tax on certain business income
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance (Taiwan tax authority)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 May through 31 May following the calendar year; for a non-calendar fiscal year, within five months after fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge equal to 10% of assessed tax, daily interest on overdue tax, default tax assessment based on estimated income, and evasion penalties up to three times the understated tax amount.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual activities report and financial statements of the private charitable foundation / tax-exemption renewal return (if the entity holds foundation status)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Supervising competent authority (e.g., Ministry of Health and Welfare or Ministry of Education) and, for tax-exemption, the National Taxation Bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after fiscal year end (by 30 April) to the supervising authority; the tax-exempt organization annual return is due by 31 May
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Loss or revocation of tax-exempt status, retroactive income tax liability, administrative fines, and judicial dissolution for material unrectified violations.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A certified public accountant audit is mandatory for non-public companies with paid-in capital of NT$30 million or more, for special licensed institutions such as banking, insurance, and securities firms, and for charitable foundations whose annual revenue or disbursements exceed the supervisory authority's threshold requiring an external audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan Financial Reporting Standards (TFRS, aligned with IFRS) for public issuers; non-public companies apply TFRS, IFRS for SMEs, or the accounting framework prescribed under the Business Entity Accounting Law; charitable foundations apply the foundation accounting standard designated by the supervising authority.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The entity must file an electronic annual confirmation with the Ministry of Economic Affairs by 31 January identifying all directors, supervisors, managers, and shareholders holding more than 10% of the share capital; any transfer or governance change must be mirror-declared within 15 days and reconciled with the physical statutory registers. Failure to maintain and confirm the UBO register suspends certain shareholder rights and attracts administrative fines.
